QuestInfo.name: Christina's Request
QuestInfo.0: While handling #p3000002#'s request, #b#p3000005##k of #b#m400030000##k has also asked for help. Help all these people in need!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p3000005##k asked you to collect #b50 #t4000739##k items from #r#o2400100##k monsters over at #b#m401010100##k. Bring them to #b#p3000002##k at #b#m400000000##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000002# is quite happy with the fur coats you brought.

0.0: Ah, Kaiser. I got jealous when I heard were spending all your time with #p3000002#. I was hoping you could give me a little attention...
0.1: The temple is sorely lacking in materials, and I need a new fur coat. I'd do it myself, but you're so strong and powerful.
0.2: Won't you go get your dear priestess some hides?

yes.0: You are so trustworthy and kind. I wish I could just keep you all to myself, but #m400000000# needs those hides more than we do. Will you take them to #b#p3000002##k for me, my darling?
yes.1: We've been using the hides of the #r#o2400100##k that live near the #b#m401010100##k. Fifty of them would do splendidly.
yes.2: Please be careful... I don't want to see a scratch on that charming face of yours. I will pray for you.

no.0: I'm satisfied with just having seen you.

1.0: #p3000005# told me you would be bringing the hides to me.

yes.0: These hides are rather beat up, but Fenelle should be able to use them.

default.0: Please take the hides to #b#p3000002##k in #b#m400000000##k.

item.0: #p3000005# told me you would be bringing hides, but this is not nearly enough. Please collect #b50 #t4000739##k items from the #r#o2400100##k monsters at the #b#m401010100##k.
